newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta wheat, barley, canola grades up vs 1995/96.
newsitem.headline: Alberta wheat, barley, canola grades up vs 1995/96.

text.p: Alberta Wheat Pool on Friday issued its first grain and oilseed grade estimates of the 1996/97 (Aug/July) crop year compared with the previous year.
Sixty-five percent of hard red spring wheat estimated to grade No1 Canada Western Red Spring versus 50 percent last year.
Eighteen percent estimated to grade No2 CWRS compared with 27 percent.
Thirteen percent estimated to grade No3 CWRS versus 20 percent.
Four percent estimated at CW Feed compared with three percent.
Barley was seen grading 26 percent malt versus 23 percent, 66 percent No1 Canada Western feed barley compared to 68 percent and nine percent No2 CW, the same as last year.

Canola was estimated to grade 85 percent No1 Canada compared with 82 percent last year, 12 percent was seen grading No2 C versus 13 percent, three percent No3 and one percent seen grading Sample, the same as last year.
